🛠️ Onsite, Remote & Drop-Off · Logan & Surrounds

Data Recovery Logan. Lost Files? Don't Panic.

Lost crucial files? Hard drive failure? Accidentally deleted important data? Computer Repairs Logan offers expert data recovery for home users and small businesses, hard drives, SSDs, USB drives, RAID/NAS and cloud storage.

Get My Data Back
✓ Hard Drive & SSD Recovery
✓ RAID & NAS Recovery
✓ Cloud & Email Recovery
✓ Ransomware-Affected Files
What We Recover

Whatever Storage It Was On, We'll Try.

Accidentally deleted photos, documents or emails. Failed, corrupted or unresponsive hard drives and SSDs. USB drives, SD cards and external drives. RAID arrays and network storage. OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Outlook and Gmail issues. Ransomware or virus-infected files.

Our Process

Diagnose First. Recover Safely.

We assess the condition of your drive or account, work out what actually caused the data loss, and pick the recovery method least likely to cause further damage, then once your files are back, we transfer them to a secure location and can set up an automatic backup so it doesn't happen again.

What's Included

Our Data Recovery Process.

A step-by-step approach to safely recover your files and prevent further data loss.

🔎

Diagnosis & Assessment

We check the condition of your HDD, SSD, USB or cloud storage, and identify the best recovery method to avoid permanent data loss.

💽

Hard Drive & SSD Recovery

Repairing and restoring files from mechanically failing or corrupted drives.

🗑️

Deleted File Recovery

Recovering lost documents, videos, images, emails and more.

🦠

Ransomware & Malware Recovery

Removing malware and retrieving files affected by ransomware or corruption.

☁️

Cloud & Email Fixes

Recovering lost files from Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox, and restoring deleted Outlook or Gmail emails.

🔒

Secure Transfer & Backup

Once recovered, we transfer files to a secure location and set up automatic backup to prevent future data loss.

Common Issues

Common Data Recovery Issues We Solve.

  • Files disappeared after an update. We restore them.
  • External drive not recognised. We fix and recover data from faulty USBs and hard drives.
  • Accidentally deleted files. We retrieve lost documents and media.
  • Emails missing in Outlook or Gmail. We recover and restore your inbox.
  • OneDrive or Google Drive sync issues. We recover files and fix cloud storage errors.
  • Corrupt or formatted drives. We extract data from damaged storage devices.
Get My Data Back
Act Fast

What To Do The Moment You Notice Data Loss.

⏸️

Stop Using The Device

Avoid overwriting the lost data, every extra write to the drive lowers your chances of a clean recovery.

🚫

Don't Attempt DIY Recovery

Incorrect recovery attempts can make files permanently unrecoverable, especially on failing hardware.

📞

Call Us ASAP

The sooner we're involved, the better the odds. Get in touch for professional recovery assistance.

Why choose Computer Repairs Logan? 15+ years of experience, transparent pricing with no hidden fees, and onsite, remote or drop-off service, see our reviews.

Related Services

Once Your Files Are Back, Protect Them.

Already got your data back? Set up ongoing backups so it doesn't happen again. If a virus or ransomware caused the data loss in the first place, our virus and spyware removal service can clean the machine properly. Recovering from a failed RAID array or network drive? Ask about a proper NAS or home file server setup for more resilient storage going forward. And if the drive itself is on its way out, our hardware repair and diagnostics team can assess whether it's worth replacing.

Frequently Asked Questions

Data Recovery Questions, Answered.

How much does data recovery cost?

Pricing depends on the type of data loss (accidental deletion, hardware failure, ransomware), the device type (HDD, SSD, USB, RAID, cloud storage), and the severity of damage (logical vs. physical failure). Get in touch for a straight quote.

What should I do if I accidentally deleted my files?

Stop using the device immediately to avoid overwriting the lost data, don't attempt DIY recovery since incorrect attempts can make files unrecoverable, and call us as soon as possible for professional recovery assistance.

Can you recover files from a completely dead hard drive?

Often, yes, we have specialised recovery tools and techniques to retrieve data from dead or unresponsive drives, though results depend on the extent and type of damage.

Do you recover lost emails and cloud files?

Yes. We restore deleted emails and fix missing files in Google Drive, OneDrive, Outlook and other cloud services.

How long does data recovery take?

Simple file recovery is usually 1 to 2 hours. Hard drive recovery typically takes 24 to 72 hours. Complex cases involving RAID, SSDs or ransomware vary based on severity.

Get Your Files Back.

Don't attempt DIY recovery on a failing drive, call us before you make it worse.
